reply.text: This is a pain-and-symptom question, so it's a medical stop: I won't assess it or suggest how to work around it. Shoulder soreness is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I'd rather you get that looked at than have me guess. Once they've cleared you, tell me what to avoid and I'll build the training around it. In the meantime I can keep the rest of your week on the legs, back or cardio side if you want to plan that out.
